message: I found myself diving into our kitchen drawer today, where I keep a little stash of essentials that sometimes feels like a treasure hunt for the kids. It’s funny how they’re always curious about what’s in there, but I can’t help but feel like I’m the one guarding my own little treasure trove of preparedness. A flashlight here, some batteries there — it’s all about being ready for whatever chaos life throws our way! What’s your go-to spot for keeping things organized at home? 😊
scene: a kitchen drawer organized with batteries, tape, and a flashlight (slightly cluttered, lived-in room)
